model.name: fileUnit.filenameNotUuidShape
model.description: A File unit carries name=filename, location=real path, sourceFile=ior:file:<real path>, ownerIor set — never a raw uuid where the name belongs. Failable gates catch uuid-name/uuid-location/uuid-sourceFile/null-owner. Root (why prod File units regressed to uuid-shape while older test is correct) = architect prod-vs-test diff; chain wired at diagnosis.
model.note: Architect wires Class/Method at root-diagnosis (prod-vs-test File diff); symptom-not-fix, do not build until root known.
